images.caption: An F-15C Eagle flies over East Anglia, England, Aug. 27, 2015, during a flyover event at Royal Air Force Lakenheath. The F-15C, assigned to the 48th Fighter Wing, circulated until it flew in unison with the U.K. Avro Vulcan XH558 to mark the first and last time these aircraft will fly together. (U.S. Air Force photo/Senior Airman Trevor T. McBride)

images.caption: A formation of U.S. Air Force F-15C Eagle aircraft assigned to the 493rd Fighter Squadron, and an F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 492nd Fighter Squadron, fly over Gloucestershire, England, July 7, 2016, to attend the upcoming Royal International Air Tattoo airshow held at RAF Fairford. The RAF Lakenheath aircraft will be on public display, along with many other military aircraft from around the U.K., to provide an opportunity for U.S. and military allies to showcase their capabilities. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Erin Trower)
images.alt: A formation of U.S. Air Force F-15C Eagle aircraft assigned to the 493rd Fighter Squadron, and an F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 492nd Fighter Squadron, fly over Gloucestershire, England, July 7, 2016, to attend the upcoming Royal International Air Tattoo airshow held at RAF Fairford.
